    Hom-dimension weights and the two unit equations #

    Once the Hom-dimension matrix and the mesh matrix are inverse, a row represented by a label P satisfies that paper's column equation Phi^T d = e_P, while a column represented by I satisfies Phi d = e_I. Nonzero maps from P, or to I, make the corresponding integral weights strictly positive.

    References #

    • The magnitude conjecture for module categories, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/magnitude-conjecture. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
